business_problem: However, their legacy data systems struggled to keep pace with their growing fleet, frequent vehicle relocations and new services, driving up costs and affecting service quality.
solution_summary: THE SWING, Korea’s leading personal mobility provider, is driving innovation with products like bicycles, e-bikes, electric kickboards and scooters. Serving over 4 million users with 120,000 vehicles, they continue to expand with offerings like the bike subscription service Swap, the premium electric bicycle Voltaire, and the Swing Taxi service. However, their legacy data systems struggled to keep pace with their growing fleet, frequent vehicle relocations and new services, driving up costs and affecting service quality. By adopting Databricks, THE SWING revolutionized operations with enhanced fleet management, IoT optimization and robust data governance.
business_outcome: THE SWING achieved measurable business impact on Databricks, including 30% Less time spent analyzing data; 40% Reduction in business operating costs; 20% Increase in revenue through the analysis of custom data.
